title: 第17章 原来是自家生意那没事了第18章 我是让你们听电话
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
满载着黑市众多父老乡亲的殷殷嘱托，
苏元带着十二艘天舟顺利返回天庭泊位。
回程的路途比去时轻松许多。
大家都把这仙舟当成自己家买卖，
正所谓众人拾柴火焰高，几位身大力不亏的武将在前方以仙索拉纤，力气小的仙吏们就在船尾奋力助推。
广寒宫的仙子为整个船队加持了隐匿行踪的潜行法阵，
天师府的道长则掐诀念咒，调转罡风风向，令船队速度陡增。
抵达泊位后，苏元才与众人依依惜别。
“苏大人，一路顺风！”
苏元对着众人作了个揖。
“此行还需仰仗诸位鼎力相助。”
转眼便到了招抚组正式开拔的日子。
勾陈天帝亲临，并且发表了长达一个半时辰的激昂演讲，高屋建瓴地布置了三大点工作任务。
随后，身为招抚组组长的太白金星又细致宣讲了一个时辰。
接着，六个工作组的组长依次上前，慷慨陈词，表态坚决完成任务。
最后由太白的铁杆心腹，本次招抚团队谈判接洽组组长许旌阳真人，郑重从够衬托仙帝手中接过那面“天庭招抚攻坚队”
的大旗。
旗舰舱室内，太白金星与许旌阳真人相对而坐，苏元则恭敬地在一旁端茶倒水。
太白金星微笑着对许真人介绍道：“老许，这位便是苏元，此次后勤保障多亏他上下打点，是个得力的……”
话音未落，飞舟猛地一个顿挫，剧烈摇晃，案几上的茶水险些泼洒出来。

太白金星眉头微蹙，并未立即发作。
苏元见状，立刻躬身请命。
“二位上仙安坐，弟子出去察看是何情况。”
他快步来到舱外，拉住一个匆忙走过的力士问道。
“怎么回事？为何突然停船？”
力士慌忙行礼答道：
“苏管事，是南天门守将……他们设卡，要检查船队。”
苏元闻言一愣，面露疑惑：
“我们是奉旨特使，持有天帝令旗，还需接受检查？”
力士不敢多言，只是引着苏元来到船首。
还真让苏元看到了老熟人。
content_en:
Full of sincere entrustments from many folks in the black market,
Su Yuan successfully returned to the heavenly berth with twelve heavenly boats.
The journey back was much easier than the journey there.
Everyone regards this fairy boat as their own business,
As the saying goes, when everyone gathers firewood, the flames will rise. A few powerful generals used fairy ropes in front to stretch the fiber, while the weak fairy officials worked hard at the stern to boost.
The fairies of Guanghan Palace blessed the entire fleet with a stealth formation that could hide their whereabouts.
The Taoist priest of Tianshi Mansion chanted a mantra to change the direction of the strong wind, causing the speed of the fleet to increase sharply.
After arriving at the berth, Su Yuancai said goodbye to everyone.
"Master Su, have a pleasant journey!"
Su Yuan bowed to everyone.
"This trip still needs your help."
In a blink of an eye, it was the day when the recruitment team officially started.
Emperor Gouchen came in person and delivered an impassioned speech that lasted for an hour and a half, laying out three major work tasks from a high position.
Afterwards, Taibai Jinxing, the leader of the recruitment team, preached in detail for another hour.
Then, the leaders of the six working groups stepped forward one after another and made impassioned speeches, expressing their determination to complete the task.
In the end, Taibai’s die-hard confidant, Xu Jingyang, the leader of the recruitment team negotiation team, solemnly took over the "Heavenly Recruitment Attack Team" from the hands of the Immortal Emperor.
flag.
In the flagship cabin, Taibai Jinxing and Xu Jingyang sat opposite each other, while Su Yuan served tea and water respectfully.
Taibai Jinxing smiled and introduced Master Xu: "Old Xu, this is Su Yuan. Thanks to him for managing the logistics support this time, he is very capable..."
Before he finished speaking, Feizhou suddenly stumbled and shook violently, and the tea on the table almost spilled.
Taibai Jinxing frowned slightly, but did not attack immediately.
When Su Yuan saw this, he immediately bowed and asked for orders.
"The two masters are seated peacefully, while my disciples go out to see what's going on."
He quickly came outside the cabin, grabbed a strongman who was passing by in a hurry and asked.
"What's going on? Why did the ship suddenly stop?"
The strongman hurriedly saluted and replied:
"Manager Su is the guard of Nantianmen... They set up a checkpoint to inspect the fleet."
Su Yuan was stunned when he heard this and looked confused:
"We are special envoys carrying orders from the Emperor of Heaven. Do we still need to be inspected?"
The powerful man didn't dare to say anything, he just led Su Yuan to the bow of the ship.
It really made Su Yuan see an old acquaintance.
